title: Swingband Pricing & Autoscale Credit Ops: Playbook for Reserved GPU Packages and SLA Tiers
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Define a pilotable pricing and contract playbook for reserved GPU capacity that introduces a 'swingband' construct (a predictable reserved base plus a managed burst reservoir) and an autoscale-credit operating model. Hypotheses: 1) Swingband reduces overcommit risk while lowering entry price for mid-market customers; 2) Autoscale credits provide measurable customer value while preserving capacity economics; 3) Tiered SLA commitments with clear credit formulas increase enterprise purchase velocity. Deliverables: pricing matrix (per-GPU equivalent/hour + burst credit price), contract appendix language for swingband mechanics and preemption/overage rules, implementation acceptance criteria for billing and metering, SQQ-ready security answers for Private/Dedicated deployment concerns, pilot cohort (3 customers) runbook, A/B experiment plan vs current reserved+burst model. Success metrics: close-rate uplift for committed deals (+10% target), reduction in average contract negotiation time (-15 days), bounded gross margin hit on burst (<8% of committed revenue), and operational stability (no more than 3 manual interventions per month during pilot).
comments: 2025-02-10 — Aisha Khan: Initial scope doc created. Mapped current reserved + burst complaints from AE feedback (pricing too binary, customers want smoother ramp). Added concept sketch for 'swingband' — a soft reservoir that auto-converts to reserved for steady usage at month-end.

2025-02-12 — Finance (Maya Gupta): Ran bottom-up sensitivity. Price floor for swingband must be ~12% below equivalent reserved to hit target adoption; burst credit pricing needs to reflect GPU-hour utilization tails. Flag: potential margin leakage if autoscale triggers and K80-like nodes are used for burst — require kernel/hw opt labeling in SKU matrix.

2025-02-17 — Sales (Jordan Reilly): Identified 7 inbound deals that would have accepted swingband. Suggested a pilot pricing anchor and legal simple appendix rather than full redline. Requested sample contract language for 'convert-to-reserve' clause and billing preview tools for customer dashboards.

2025-02-24 — Engineering (ENG-1972, Priya Menon): Reviewed metering implications. Proposed two counters: reserved-normalized-GB-hours and burst-credit-usage. Autoscale credit accounting will need a deterministic debounce (30s) to avoid token churn inflation. Engineering estimate: 3 sprints for metering + 1 sprint for billing export changes. Dependency on runtime labels for 'burst-eligible' kernels.

2025-02-26 — Design (DES-431): Wireframes for customer-facing billing preview and swingband utilization chart uploaded to Drive. Emphasis on showing 'convert-to-reserve' forecast and projected savings vs on-demand.

2025-03-01 — Legal (Sophie Laurent): Drafted SLA appendix with three tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze). Proposed SLA credit formula: min( (SLO_target - observed_uptime) * monthly_commit * credit_rate, cap ). Legal flagged need for explicit force-majeure and maintenance windows for region-level outages. Also requested security questionnaire answers for Private mode: KMS integration, customer audit log exports, and HSM details.

2025-03-03 — Security (Rahul Banerjee): Provided SQQ draft items: encryption-at-rest details, KMS rotations, SOC2 audit status, network isolation options for VPC deployments, and RBAC controls for console access. Marked two items as needing product changes: 1) provide per-token audit export for dedicated; 2) expose customer-managed key integration in Private installer. These are blockers for some enterprise pilots.

2025-03-04 — PM (Aisha Khan): Incorporated legal and security feedback. Updated pilot runbook and candidate customer list (names redacted). Plan: 6-week pilot, measure conversion rate, operational toil, and margin impact. Raised dependency on pricing experiments with Growth for A/B funnel tracking.

2025-03-05 — Next steps (Liam O'Connor): Confirm engineering capacity and slot pilot start date with Solutions Eng. Action items: 1) ENG to finalize metering schema and billing export (owner: Priya, due 2025-03-18); 2) Legal to finalize appendix and one-pager for AEs (owner: Sophie, due 2025-03-12); 3) Growth to QA A/B experiment instrumentation (owner: Maya, due 2025-03-20).
